simulations.label: SIMULATION — practice only. Not a licence, not a certification, not a credential, not a diagnosis, not advice for any real person, site or deal.
simulations.scenario: A first self-reading: sit, breathe, notice, name what is happening — and check it with a partner.

scoring.notes: Practice in noticing, not an assessment. Nothing here diagnoses anyone.
scoring.pass: All steps in order, every check passed. Practice score only — it certifies nothing.

steps.action: Sit in the grove, breathe, and notice one thing that is happening right now.
steps.check: One thing noticed and named in plain words.
steps.if_wrong: Name one thing, not everything. One is enough.

steps.action: Write it in a journal, in your own words.
steps.check: Written down; the journal stays with the writer.

steps.action: Take it to the Other-Reader Commons and reflect it back with a partner: hear, reflect, check.
steps.check: Partner reflects it back; you confirm or correct.
steps.if_wrong: A reflection unchecked is a guess. Check it.

steps.action: Note one thing you will practise next time.
steps.if_wrong: Name the next step. Practice without a next step stalls.

simulations.title: First Reading — notice, name, check

simulations.label: SIMULATION — practice only. Not a licence, not a certification, not a credential, not a diagnosis, not advice for any real person, site or deal.
simulations.scenario: Run a repair circle: name the break, name the need, agree the fix, make it.

scoring.notes: Repair starts with the break, not the blame. Practice only.
scoring.pass: All steps in order, every check passed. Practice score only — it certifies nothing.

steps.action: Name the break: what happened, in plain words, without blame.
steps.if_wrong: Blame is not a break. Name what happened.

steps.action: Name the need: what is needed now, in one sentence.
steps.if_wrong: One need, not a list. Name it.

steps.action: Agree the fix together, and write it down.
steps.check: Fix agreed by everyone and written down.
steps.if_wrong: An unagreed fix is not a fix. Agree it.

steps.action: Make the fix, then check: did it hold?
steps.check: Fix made; the check done and noted.
steps.if_wrong: A fix unchecked is a fix unproven. Check it.

simulations.title: Repair Circle — name the break, agree the fix

Fabric: 34 nodes total (scene root + 20 top-level + nested Agent/Swarm children); 12 distinct GLB refs, all unhosted — see missing_models.

Districts/buildings = the real 'Zone · ...' nodes. NPCs = the real 'Agent · ...' nodes (nested under their zones; NPC position = zone position + the agent node's local offset) plus all three real 'Advisor · ...' nodes (Host Advisor, Steward Liaison, Alignment Advisor; top-level fabric positions through the world transform). The 'Steward seat 1–3 · human' nodes are human seats, not game characters, and are not NPCs. All NPC dialogue is original game dialogue, never attributed to a real person.
Biome 'grove' is a design choice for this interpretation.
Agent companions are game characters representing the real Virtuals agents (agents.json); their live instances are offline — not live connections.
Zones (6): Self-Reader Grove, Other-Reader Commons, Repairer's Hall, Room-Reader Plaza, Practitioner Workshop, Steward Council.

stations.content: The grove practises self-reading: sit, breathe, notice what is happening, name it in plain words. It does not assess or diagnose anyone. Journals written here stay with the writer.
stations.name: Self-Reader Grove — notice yourself
stations.summary: A practice in noticing, not an assessment.

stations.content: The hall teaches repair: name the break, name the need, agree the fix, make it. Practice apology notes are rewritten until they are honest. Nothing here is therapy and nobody here is assessed.
stations.name: Repairer's Hall — name the break, agree the fix
stations.summary: Repair starts with the break, not the blame.

stations.content: The plaza teaches room-reading: enter, notice the light, the sound, the exits and who can see whom, name what the room needs, adjust. A practice in attention, not a test.
stations.name: Room-Reader Plaza — read the room
stations.summary: A room speaks before anyone does.

stations.content: The workshop runs exercises in order, and every exercise ends with a debrief: what worked, what was hard, what to try next. The debrief is where the learning happens — skipping it ends the exercise, not the learning.
stations.name: Practitioner Workshop — practise, then debrief
stations.summary: The learning is in the debrief.
